title: V 来 V 去 (V around)
longExplanation: V around. Pinyin: V lái V qù

examples.sentence: 小狗追着自己的尾巴， 在草地上跑来跑去。
examples.romanization: xiǎogǒu zhuī zhe zìjǐ de wěiba， zài cǎo dìshang pǎo lái pǎo qù。
examples.translation: The dog chased his tail and ran around on the grass.

examples.sentence: 还好碰见你了，要不/不然/要不然我今天肯定要迟到了。
examples.romanization: háihǎo pèngjiàn nǐ le， yàobù/ bùrán/ yàobùrán wǒ jīntiān kěndìng yào chí dàoliǎo。
examples.translation: Fortunately, I ran into you, otherwise I must have been late today.

title: 要不/不然/要不然 (why not try)
longExplanation: why not try. Pinyin: yàobù/ bùrán/ yàobùrán

examples.sentence: 今天太晚了，要不/不然/要不然你明天再走吧。
examples.romanization: jīntiān tài wǎn le， yàobù/ bùrán/ yàobùrán nǐ míngtiān zài zǒu ba。
examples.translation: It’s too late today, why don’t (you) leave tomorrow instead?
Good friends should help each other.
We (us two) have the same hobbies.

examples.sentence: 咱们俩彼此彼此， 我画得比你好不了多少。
examples.romanization: zánmen liǎ bǐcǐbǐcǐ， wǒ huà dé bǐ nǐhǎo bùliǎo duōshao。
examples.translation: We (the two of us) are pretty much the same, I can't paint much better than you.

examples.sentence: 这钱就算我借给你的，将来你有了的时候再还我。
examples.romanization: zhè qián jiùsuàn wǒ jiègěi nǐ de， jiānglái nǐ yǒule de shíhou zài hái wǒ。
examples.translation: Let’s just say that the money is loaned to you, you can pay me back when you have [more money].

title: V 了/掉 算了 (might as well V)
longExplanation: might as well V. Pinyin: V le/ diào suànle

examples.sentence: 不就是一个空瓶子吗？扔掉算了。
examples.romanization: bù jiùshì yī gè kōng píngzi ma？ rēngdiào suànle。
examples.translation: Isn't it just an empty bottle? Might as well throw it away.

examples.sentence: 作为大作家、大学问家，鲁迅对吃很讲究。
examples.romanization: zuòwéi dà zuòjiā、 dàxué wèn jiā， Lǔ Xùn duì chī hěn jiǎngjiu。
examples.translation: As a great writer and a great intellectual, Lu Xun is very particular about eating.

examples.sentence: 孔子曾经带着学生周游各国14年，传播他的思想。
examples.romanization: Kǒngzǐ céngjīng dài zhe xuésheng zhōuyóu gèguó14 nián， chuánbō tā de sīxiǎng。
examples.translation: Confucius once took students around the country for 14 years, spreading his thoughts.

examples.sentence: 虽然我们遇到了很多困难，但毕竟完成了任务。
examples.romanization: suīrán wǒmen yù dàoliǎo hěn duō kùnnan， dàn bìjìng wánchéng le rènwu。
examples.translation: Although we have encountered a lot of difficulties, we have completed the task after all.

examples.sentence: 食物越来越少，老人不得不逐渐限制猴子的食量。
examples.romanization: shíwù yuèláiyuè shǎo， lǎorén bùdébù zhújiàn xiànzhì hóuzi de shíliàng。
examples.translation: With less and less food, the elderly have to gradually limit the amount of food they eat.

examples.sentence: 虽然以前她不支持你，但或许这次会有变化。
examples.romanization: suīrán yǐqián tā bù zhīchí nǐ， dàn huòxǔ zhè cì huì yǒu biànhuà。
examples.translation: Although she did not support you before, maybe this time things will change.

title: V 过来 (V and recover)
longExplanation: V and recover. Pinyin: V guòlái

examples.sentence: 过了半天，脑子才清醒过来。
examples.romanization: guò le bàntiān， nǎozi cái qīngxǐng guòlái。
examples.translation: My head cleared up only after a long time,

pattern: V 得过来 / V 不过来
title: V 得过来 / V 不过来 (can finish V / cannot finish V)
shortExplanation: can finish V / cannot finish V
longExplanation: can finish V / cannot finish V. Pinyin: V dé guòlái / V bùguò lái
formation: V dé guòlái / V bùguò lái

examples.sentence: 天上的星星那么多，谁数得过来呀？
examples.romanization: tiānshàng de xīngxing nàme duō， shéi shǔ dé guòlái ya？
examples.translation: There are so many stars in the sky, who can count them (out)?
